newsitem.title: USA: Transmedia earnings report delayed by SEC query.
newsitem.headline: Transmedia earnings report delayed by SEC query.

text.p: Transmedia Network Inc said on Tuesday it delayed announcing its fourth quarter and year-end results because of U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission questions regarding membership marketing costs.

The company said the SEC questioned whether SOP 93-7 was applicable to Transmedia. This rule required marketing and other costs associated with developing a membership base to be amortized over the same period in which resulting card usage revenues were included as income, the company said.
Transmedia said it hoped SOP-37 was properly applied, and it also hoped to resolve the matter promptly.
Results had been due out on December 6.

Transmedia is a membership-based company that issues a charge card designed, it said, to provide its members with a convenient way to save on the purchase of products and services such as restaurants, hotels, airlines, catalogs, and other recreational facilities.
